name: Laura Ingalls Wilder Homestead
unique: The surveyor's house and the Ingalls family homes from the Little House books, with a pageant in summer and the prairie around them unchanged.
buzz: Readers come from other countries and the guides know the books and the family; the summer pageant is the local tradition.

name: Black Hills Institute
unique: The fossil laboratory and museum behind the commercial diggers, with a T. rex named Sue's original bones and a wall of ammonites.
buzz: The prep lab is the reason paleontology people stop and the museum is small; the institute also runs digs you can join.

name: Prehistoric Indian Village
unique: A thousand year old village of earth lodges under a protective dome, with an active dig and a lab where students process what they find.
buzz: The dig under the dome is the reason to come and the site is active in summer; it pairs with the Corn Palace down the road.

name: Akta Lakota Museum
unique: A museum on the Missouri with a collection of Lakota beadwork, quillwork and star quilts, free and run by the school.
buzz: The star quilts and beadwork are the highlights and it is free; the river overlook outside is the photograph.

name: National Music Museum
unique: One of the great instrument collections in the world, with Stradivarius violins, early keyboards and a saxophone once owned by Adolphe Sax.
buzz: Musicians call it a pilgrimage and the collection is bigger than the town; the staff will demonstrate some instruments.

name: Gavins Point Dam
unique: A Missouri River dam with a visitor center, a fish hatchery and a below dam tailwater where bald eagles winter by the dozen.
buzz: The eagles in winter are the reason photographers come and the dam tour explains the flood control; the visitor center is free.

name: South Dakota State Fair
unique: The state fair on the prairie with livestock shows, a draft horse pull, a carnival and grandstand concerts.
buzz: The livestock barns and the horse pull are the real fair and the concerts draw the region; it is hot and the parking is in fields.

name: Bramble Park Zoo
unique: A small zoo in a city park with a carousel and a train, plus a collection of big cats and primates, in a town of 22,000.
buzz: Parents like the size and the train and the zoo is cheap; the park around it has a swimming pool and picnic areas.

name: Lake Herman State Park
company: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks
unique: A wooded lake park with a campground, a beach and a historic stone cabin, in the lake country of eastern South Dakota.
buzz: The lake is quiet and the campground is shaded; it is a good stop between Sioux Falls and the Minnesota line.

name: 1880 Train
unique: A steam train that climbs a 4 percent grade through the Black Hills between Hill City and Keystone, with open cars and a view of the granite peaks.
buzz: The steam engine and the climb are the reason to ride and the open car is the seat to book; the round trip takes two hours.

name: Hill City
unique: A small Black Hills town on the Mickelson Trail with a main street of galleries, a winery and the 1880 Train depot, surrounded by granite peaks.
buzz: The town is the base for the Mickelson Trail and the train; it is quieter than Keystone and the food is better.
